name: PD 81 was established by Ordinance No. 14960, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 18, 1975. Ordinance No. 14960 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 14960; 25423)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 81 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-81.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 81 was established by Ordinance No. 14960, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 18, 1975. Ordinance No. 14960 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 14960; 25423)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-81.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 81 is established on property generally located along the east line of Longacre Lane, south of Ledbetter Drive. The size of PD 81 is approximately 6.85 acres. (Ord. Nos. 14960; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-81.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS. article.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Site Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-81.104.SITE PLAN. Utilization of the Property must be in accordance with a city plan commission approved site plan (Exhibit 81A), which must be attached to and made a part of Ordinance No. 14960. (Ord. Nos. 14960; 25423)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-81.105.PARKING. Parking must be provided at a ratio of one space per 200 square feet of floor area. (Ord. Nos. 14960; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-81.106.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the sign regulations of Article IV of Chapter 41 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 14960; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-81.107.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Compliance with the requirements of all city departments is required.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)No certificate of occupancy shall be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 14960; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-81.108.ZONING MAP. PD 81 is located on Zoning Map Nos. N-9 and N-10. (Ord. 25423)
